description: Menteş, Sibel and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The completed application evaluates a ten-year WRF wind simulation using forty-seven Turkish observation stations. The reported analysis examines model errors and distinguishes land and coastal settings. This case supports assessment of regional wind-resource simulation performance under the stated configuration and period. It does not establish uniform station quality, a universally optimal WRF setup or an openly released copy of every observation series. Exact calendar dates remain unspecified in the inspected description. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
